summary.text: Laura Supica is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 22 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Supica has served in the Maine House since 2020 and has chaired the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Laura Supica lives in Bangor, Maine, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as an executive assistant in the office of the Maine Secretary of State.
She has volunteered with the Eastern Area Agency on Aging and the Mabel Wadsworth Center.
Supica was elected to Maine House District 126 in 2020, succeeding John Schneck, and won District 22 in 2022 and 2024.
In 2023-2024 she chaired the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee.
Ballotpedia lists no opponent for her in the 2026 general election.
